title: Films
descriptionFa: انواع فیلم، آدم‌های سینما، و حرف زدن درباره‌ی فیلمی که دیدی.

words.example: My grandfather's favourite film is an old western.
The children are watching a cartoon about a talking dog.
I can't watch a horror film alone at night.
This comedy is so funny that I cried.
The thriller was so exciting that I couldn't stop watching.
There are lots of car chases in this action film.
In this science fiction film, people live on Mars.
The Sound of Music is a famous musical.
We watched a romantic comedy about two students who fall in love.
Golshifteh Farahani is an Iranian film star.
words.tipFa: بازیگر مرد: actor، بازیگر زن: actress (یا actor).

words.example: Asghar Farhadi is a famous Iranian director.
Who is going to play the hero in the new film?
words.tipFa: بازی کردن در یه فیلم: be in a film: She was in the new Bond film.

words.example: Have you seen the latest Farhadi film?
We go to the cinema once a month.
words.tipFa: با the: go to the cinema، نه go to cinema. آمریکایی‌ها go to the movies می‌گن.

words.meaningFa: چی نشون می‌ده؟ (برنامه‌ی سینما یا تلویزیون)
words.example: Let's check what's on at the cinema on Friday.
words.tipFa: What's on at the cinema? نه What's on the cinema?
همیشه با مفعول: I enjoyed it، نه فقط I enjoyed.

words.example: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
words.tipFa: فیلم boring هست، ولی من bored هستم (حوصله‌م سر رفته).
